f33r.name: Plant
f33r.looks: Two green-and-white rayed flower heads on swollen pale stalks with a small third head, broad pointed green leaves and a spreading orange-brown root with a face drawn faintly at each end.

f33v.name: Plant
f33v.looks: Two large oval flower heads with blue petals round yellow centres on tall thin stalks, four spiky green leaf clusters and a brown root ending in three round knobs.

f34r.name: Plant
f34r.looks: Three nodding flower heads with green bracts and dark blue centres on long pale stalks, fringed green leaves and a spreading pink-brown root of many long strands.

f34v.name: Plant
f34v.looks: Branching pale stems carrying rows of round green and brown cup-shaped leaves, three outlined flower heads at the top, and a thick pinkish-brown root splitting into many strands.

f35r.name: Plant
f35r.looks: A single flower with curled dark blue petals on a red-streaked stalk above a large brown cup-shaped leaf with a green fringed top, a long red-streaked stem and two spreading red-lined roots.

f35v.name: Plant
f35v.looks: A tall plant with a dense green crown of lobed leaves, a pale green stem wound with twisting stalks, clusters of small teal and red-brown berries, lobed green leaves and a long brown root with many curling fingers.

f36r.name: Plant
f36r.looks: Thin pale stems topped by four small blue flowers, many lobed green leaves and two yellow ones, rising from a swollen pale base with short brown clawed roots.

f36v.name: Plant
f36v.looks: A thin pale stem with star-shaped green leaf rosettes, brown knobbly catkins near the top and a brown root of many parallel strands.

f37r.name: Plant
f37r.looks: Clusters of small round red-and-white berries on branching stalks at the top, a straight pale stem with long drooping green leaves, and a short brown root of curling strands.

f37v.name: Plant
f37v.looks: Three dark blue buds tipped with red-and-white flowers above a pale stem lined with paired arching green leaves with scalloped outlines, and a thick dark brown root splitting into long strands.

f38r.name: Plant
f38r.looks: A large green V-shaped leaf with saw-toothed edges and comma-shaped cut-outs, a pale cup at its base on a thin pink stem, two small cup-shaped flowers on stalks near the bottom, and spreading red-brown root strands.

f38v.name: Plant
f38v.looks: A tall dense mass of overlapping diamond-shaped leaves in green, olive-brown and pale grey with a dark blue star-like flower at the top, on a red-lined stem ending in a forked olive-brown root.

f39r.name: Plant
f39r.looks: A row of upright shoots with long pointed dark-dotted green leaves on pale stems, one bearing a dark blue bell with a small yellow flower, all standing on a flat oval base with many long pinkish-brown roots.

f39v.name: Plant
f39v.looks: Two round heads of small blue-and-white flowers on thin stalks above long green leaves with pale notches, a pale stem and a broad base with many long pinkish-brown roots.

f40r.name: Plant
f40r.looks: A round blue-and-white flower on a tall spindle-shaped stalk banded olive green, two forked pale green stems with fan-like fringed blue-green leaves, and a spreading mass of long thin red-brown roots.

f40v.name: Plant
f40v.looks: A large round flower head ringed with blue, green and white petals and curling tendrils above a red cone streaked with green, a thin pale green stem, two broad fringed green leaves and a cluster of round brown bulbs.

f40v.name: Small plant
f40v.looks: Three fringed green leaves on thin pale stalks gathered above three drooping round brown bulbs.

f41r.name: Plant
f41r.looks: A pale stem with paired branches carrying rounded fan-shaped green leaves edged with small loops, a faint pale bud at the top, and a thick olive-brown root splitting into two with many fine strands.

f41v.name: Plant
f41v.looks: A broad head of small dark blue dots on fine fanned stalks, deeply lobed curly-edged green leaves, thin curling stalks and two long red-brown root tubers that cross at the top.

f42r.name: Plant
f42r.looks: A large pointed green leaf with pale veins at the top of a long thin pale stem, a side stalk with three rounded red leaflets, and long thin pale brown roots spreading along the bottom of the page.

f42v.name: Plant
f42v.looks: A pale yellow star-shaped flower with a dark eye-like centre on a long thin pale stem, a cluster of large broad pointed green leaves, and a few long pale red-brown roots.

f43r.name: Plant
f43r.looks: A long low mound of overlapping scale-like green-and-white leaves on many thin blue-and-white stems, with seven yellow flower heads on stalks above and a dense mass of wavy red-brown roots below.

f43v.name: Plant
f43v.looks: A thin pale stem with clusters of long narrow pointed green leaves, a small pale flower bud with a frilled tip, and a thick olive-brown root coiled like a snake and edged with short bristles.

f43v.name: Plant
f43v.looks: Many pale stems carrying curled dark green leaves like hooks and spikes of small blue-and-white flowers, above a loose tangle of long thin pale roots.

f44r.name: Plant
f44r.looks: A small white-and-yellow flower over green sepals on a short pinkish stalk, a large fan of overlapping green and dark blue leaves, and a long pale pink stem curving into a root with red spots and claw-like red spurs.
